transcript.text: Here is my formal IP readout for the record. Finding: I reviewed the university's master research agreement and the controlling schedule they supplied overnight. Background patents U1, U2, and U3 are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use. The current draft grants the university partner an exclusive commercial license to all background technology used in the project, which would improperly include these three patents. Required actions before execution: (1) The final agreement must explicitly exclude patents U1, U2, and U3 from any commercial license granted under this agreement. (2) The agreement must require separate written university consent before any commercial use of those three patents. I have not yet incorporated these changes into the draft or circulated this finding prior to this meeting, but I am putting it on the record now.

The working-session minutes have not yet been circulated to the deal team. The current draft permits publication of project results without these restrictions. Required actions before execution: (1) The final agreement must explicitly prohibit publication containing patient-level data. (2) The agreement must require de-identification of all data before any permitted external publication of project results. I have not yet incorporated these changes into the draft, but I am putting this on the record now.
